Rule: for EVERY COLOR-2 (red) CELL, check its 4 cardinal neighbors. If ALL 4 cardinal neighbors are NON-RED (any non-2 value), RECOLOR that cell to COLOR 3 (green). If ≥1 cardinal neighbor IS red (part of a multi-cell component), KEEP it as 2. Net: cardinally isolated red singletons become green; multi-cell red blobs stay red.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent recolor mask of singleton red coordinates; for this qualified 8-neighbor case it is [[0, 0], [2, 4]].
sequential_dependency.step_a: Build red-cell connected components using the episode-selected 4-neighbor or 8-neighbor adjacency relation, then identify exactly the singleton components.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Copy the input grid and recolor exactly the coordinates in the computed singleton mask from red (2) to green (3), preserving every other cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The recolor mask cannot be chosen before connectivity is computed; under 4-neighbor adjacency the diagonal pair also becomes two singleton targets, changing the final grid.
